The original half of a translated pair, so the reading surface has two notes
that belong beside one another. Its partner declares this note as the source it
was translated from.

It carries a footnote[^window] and an address the author wrote at one of this
note's own sections: [the second movement](#second-movement). Both of those land
inside this note wherever it is shown, including beside another note.

## Ledger

The heading both halves keep untranslated, so two notes shown together would
name one element twice if each kept the name it has on its own page.

## Second movement

The second heading, so the contents list has more than one place to point at.

[^window]: The footnote this half defines, numbered from one in its own column.
